final_message:
I fixed the yen formatting, and a direct check now prints `Paid ¥500 by card`. I couldn't confirm the yen receipt test itself passes. `node --test` hung and had to be killed, even when I ran only that one file. I didn't investigate why it hangs.

**Cause:** `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` divided every amount by 100 and added two decimals. Yen has no minor unit, so 500 came out as `¥5.00`.

**Fix:** I added a small `ZERO_DECIMAL` set containing `JPY`. Currencies in it are printed as the plain integer, and every other currency formats as before. A USD receipt still prints `Paid $5.00 by card`.

`formatMoney` is shared, so invoice lines and cart totals now show yen correctly too. They had the same bug, and no other tests or code reference JPY.
